reviews.review:
Where do I start...


I recommend this game. I HIGHLY recommend this game. 
It's one of those kinds of games where you farm for the things you want. Sure, you can pay real money and just buy (SOME) of the stuff in the game, but a lot of the items you need to farm for. It's a free to play/pay to bling style game. 
This game rewards you for your time spent in it. And it's all about progression. Getting stronger. I can still think back to when I started two years ago around this time, when I was just learning how to get around the maps quickly and what kind of damage is best for each enemy. Now I'm at the point where I spend an hour per mission making sure that I get the best out of every game I play on here. I have met many people and made even more friends over Warframe, and I hope to continue doing this. The developers (Digital Extremes) have been working on this game for quite a few years, and continue to pump out new FREE content updates. New quests, new weapons, new warframes. 

Now, to what I said about paying to bling. Warframe has an in game premium currency called Platinum. It is used to buy just about anything in the game, with some exceptions, you can rush build timers on your foundry, and you can use it as a stable currency in the player run economy. Personally, I recommend you save your platinum for the cosmetics, as there aren't many that you can just create from farming. 

Leveling in the game is fun, and easy when you get it rolling. All player items max out at level 30, which isn't much, but you can reset the level using an in game item that allows you to tinker your items even more. Now, you're thinking, "Oh, only level 30? In a bit of time I'd be able to take out anything in one hit."
WRONG 
The highest level enemy that I have seen that was non-event was a level 237 Ancient Healer (A tanky infested enemy) And it saw me, and instantly downed me when I had 800 shields and 500 Health. The game will get harder as you go longer, so don't think it will get easy just because you put enough time into it.


Overall, I give the game a 10/10. I recommend you get at least one friend to play with before starting this game. Feel free to add me if you want to play together sometime!


**EDIT DONE 11/23/16**
So, After these Nomination awards came out, I decided to give Warframe the "There was something in my eye" Award. The reason why I gave it this nomination, was because once they added in the Cinematic Quest, it had actually made me tear up a little as it explains the lore somewhat (Which I knew beforehand). I have to say, the amount of work that they put into the game over these years has been somewhat of a roller coaster, but I say, the game is great, put time into it, get 3 friends to play with, and have fun.



**Edit done 7/1/2019**
Nice

After playing for just 20 hours i feel this game is just all about grinding the same kinda mobs over and over again to get gear..... is get pretty mono after awhile. Yeah the ninja style shooter thingy initially is cool but after awhile you just feel is just grinding of similar mobs over and over again to get mats and exp. So in one word the game is just about GRIND.

Decided to come back after much hype in youtube,,,,, saw a nice frame decided to buy then i ask in the forum chat more info about the frames. Then i found out even if you use money to buy the frame you are still required to level your char to certain Master Rank to use it. And the worse part there is no information in the market to indicate the requirement. Nearly got conned.... So please people before spending your money please ask clearly.... not sure why the developer didn't put in the requirements?

I have always identified myself as a Rhino. Warframe cares about my feelings and helps me roleplay myself in this beautiful game, now i can charge around and penetrate my big horn into flesh like i always wanted.
